description: Model the live AgentCore Memory resource 'FinancialAdvisorMemory' in CDK using the real L2 Memory construct (AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Memory) from aws-cdk-lib/aws-bedrockagentcore, with the three live strategies/namespaces and 90-day event expiry, and wire it into ProductionHardeningStack. This feature is a prerequisite for FEAT-002 because FEAT-002's IAM statement references the memory ARN produced here.
steps: Create infra/lib/memory-construct.ts exporting a MemoryConstruct (extends constructs.Construct) with a documented Props interface { environment: string }. Import { Memory, MemoryStrategy } from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-bedrockagentcore' and cdk from 'aws-cdk-lib'.

Inside the construct, create `new Memory(this, 'FinancialAdvisorMemory', { memoryName: 'FinancialAdvisorMemory', description: 'Memory for personal finance advisor agent', expirationDuration: cdk.Duration.days(90), memoryStrategies: [ MemoryStrategy.usingSemantic({ strategyName: 'financial_facts', description: 'Extracts and stores user financial facts (income, expenses, goals)', namespaces: ['finance/user/{actorId}/facts'] }), MemoryStrategy.usingUserPreference({ strategyName: 'user_preferences', description: 'Captures user preferences for investment risk, budget priorities', namespaces: ['finance/user/{actorId}/preferences'] }), MemoryStrategy.usingSummarization({ strategyName: 'conversation_summary', description: 'Summarizes financial advisory conversations', namespaces: ['finance/user/{actorId}/sessions/{sessionId}'] }) ] })`.
Expose `public readonly memoryArn: string` (= memory.memoryArn) and `public readonly memoryId: string` (= memory.memoryId) on the construct.
Add a cdk.CfnOutput for the memory id (description + exportName `${props.environment}-agentcore-memory-id`).

Add a block comment documenting that the strategy names, namespaces, and 90-day expiry mirror AWS_Deployment.ipynb Phase 3.2.1 and the live resource FinancialAdvisorMemory-7Yqinr2IDl, and that the three strategy types map to CFN SemanticMemoryStrategy / UserPreferenceMemoryStrategy / SummaryMemoryStrategy.

In infra/lib/production-hardening-stack.ts, import MemoryConstruct and instantiate it (const memory = new MemoryConstruct(this, 'MemoryConstruct', { environment: props.environment })) BEFORE the existing IamConstruct instantiation. Add a CfnOutput 'MemoryId' exporting memory.memoryId with exportName `${props.environment}-agentcore-memory-id` if not already emitted by the construct (avoid duplicate exportName — emit it in exactly one place).
Do not modify any unrelated construct (Cognito, ECR, CodeBuild, Amplify, WAF, Secrets, Guardrail, S3).
acceptance_criteria: `cd infra && npm run build` compiles with no TypeScript errors.
`cd infra && npx cdk synth` succeeds for both ProductionHardening-Staging and ProductionHardening-Production.

cdk.out contains an AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Memory resource named FinancialAdvisorMemory with the three strategies and the exact namespaces finance/user/{actorId}/facts, finance/user/{actorId}/preferences, finance/user/{actorId}/sessions/{sessionId}, and a 90-day event expiry.
No package.json dependency versions were changed.
verification: git -C infra diff --exit-code package.json (no version changes)
findings: FEAT-002 wiring reference: New file infra/lib/memory-construct.ts exports class MemoryConstruct (props: { environment: string }). In infra/lib/production-hardening-stack.ts it is instantiated as `const memory = new MemoryConstruct(this, 'MemoryConstruct', { environment: props.environment })`, placed immediately BEFORE `const iam = new IamConstruct(...)`. The memory ARN FEAT-002 needs is exposed as the public readonly string property `memory.memoryArn` (also `memory.memoryId`). FEAT-002 should pass `memory.memoryArn` into IamConstruct props and add the AgentCoreMemoryAccess least-privilege IAM statement there (do NOT add it in memory-construct.ts). The memory id CfnOutput is emitted ONCE, inside MemoryConstruct, with construct id 'MemoryId', description `AgentCore memory id for FinancialAdvisorMemory (<environment>)`, and exportName `${props.environment}-agentcore-memory-id` (staging and production). Do not re-emit that exportName in the stack (would collide). The L2 Memory logical construct id is 'FinancialAdvisorMemory' (memoryName 'FinancialAdvisorMemory'); the inner `const memory` local in the construct holds the aws-bedrockagentcore Memory instance. Note: within memory-construct.ts the IAM-consumable value is this.memoryArn; the `memory` local in the stack is currently unused by design (tsconfig noUnusedLocals=false, so no TS error) and becomes used once FEAT-002 passes memory.memoryArn to IamConstruct. Verified: npm ci, npm run build (tsc exit 0), npx cdk synth (both ProductionHardening-Staging and -Production). cdk.out contains AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Memory with EventExpiryDuration: 90 and the three strategies rendered as SemanticMemoryStrategy / UserPreferenceMemoryStrategy / SummaryMemoryStrategy with namespaces finance/user/{actorId}/facts, finance/user/{actorId}/preferences, finance/user/{actorId}/sessions/{sessionId}. package.json unchanged. (Reminder for FEAT-002 verification: tsc outDir is ./cdk.out, so a compiled cdk.out/lib/memory-construct.js also appears in greps — it is a gitignored build artifact, not source.)
